analysis.summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited presented its FY26 investor presentation detailing its manufacturing capabilities, product segments, and financial track record. The company manufactures specialty performance chemicals with an installed capacity of 22,000 MTPA in Ahmedabad and reported revenue from operations of INR 110.7 crores for FY26. Management highlighted its diverse product portfolio spanning polymers, surfactants, silicones, and ester & bio-based sustainable solutions. The presentation also outlined growth strategies focusing on geographic expansion, new product launches, and increasing presence across end-user industries such as home and personal care. Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported strong financial results for FY26, with revenue growing 32% year-on-year to INR110.7 crores and EBITDA increasing 53% to INR22.6 crores, supported by improved capacity utilization, a favorable product mix, and operating leverage.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company expects to reach around 65% capacity utilization by the end of the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: broadly we anticipate that by the end of the current fiscal year, we should reach around 65% capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Management targets bio-based esters and silicones to contribute around 55% to 60% of total revenue over the next two years.
guidance.quote: We would like these two categories to contribute around 55% to 60% of our total revenue over the next two years.

guidance.claim: Management expects R&D spend to remain in the range of around 2% to 3% for the current year.
guidance.quote: We would like to maintain it in the range of around 2% to 3% for this year, and thereafter it would be need-based

guidance.claim: Management reiterated sustainable financial margins of around 35% gross margin, 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and 10% to 12% PAT margin.
guidance.quote: we believe these margins are sustainable for this kind of product mix and the industries that we currently cater to, around 35% gross margin, around 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and around 10% to 12% PAT margin.

guidance.claim: Management targets textile revenue contribution to come down to below 50% of the total revenue over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Going forward, over the next three years, while we will continue to grow in textiles, the textile contribution should come down to below 50% of the total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that customers are currently in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks regarding procurement due to cooling off of prices.
demand_outlook.quote: now that the prices are cooling off a little bit, we see that customers are in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks, and broadly, they will start procurement again for their next production cycle.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that Home and Personal Care is viewed as a strategically important growth area due to favorable industry dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: We view HPC as a strategically important growth area, given its favorable industry dynamics, higher value-added product opportunities, and alignment with long-term consumer trends such as premiumization, hygiene awareness, and sustainable ingredients.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Indian companies providing right products and services are getting significant benefits from multinational company consolidation in textiles.
demand_outlook.quote: since 75% of the business is still in textiles, there has been a lot of consolidation in multinational companies, wherein Indian companies that are providing the right products and right services are getting significant benefits.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that global chemical markets increasingly treat sustainability as a core procurement criterion rather than a preference.
demand_outlook.quote: Across global chemical markets, sustainability is increasingly becoming a core procurement criteria rather than a preference.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company possesses significant embedded growth potential with nearly 47% capacity headroom without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term.
capex_expansion.quote: with nearly 47% capacity headroom still available within our existing facility, we possess significant embedded growth potential without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the Dholka land parcel provides strategic flexibility for future capacity creation when required.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, our land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for the next phase of expansion whenever business requirements warrant additional capacity creation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: we will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that FY26 EBITDA increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with EBITDA margins expanding to 20.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 20.4%, an expansion of over 300 plus basis points over the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that profitability improvement was driven by product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage benefits, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: The improvement in profitability was driven by a combination of favorable product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage benefits, and continued cost discipline across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that roughly 30% of raw materials used are directly related to crude.
margins_costs.quote: around 30% of the raw materials that we use are directly related to crude.

margins_costs.claim: Management mentioned that finance costs remained largely stable supported by phased deployment of IPO proceeds and borrowing repayments.
margins_costs.quote: Finance cost remained largely stable despite business expansion, supported by phase deployment of IPO proceeds and repayment of borrowings.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that PAT for FY26 stood at INR12 crores with PAT margin improving by 197 basis points to 10.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for FY26 stood at INR12 crores, representing a growth of 62% year-on-year. PAT margin improved by 197 basis points to 10.6%, reflecting both operating leverage and improved profitability across the business.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for FY26 was reported at 52.7% with production of 11,589 MT.
Management stated that the integrated manufacturing facility at Moraiya, Ahmedabad, has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our integrated manufacturing facility located at Moraiya, Ahmedabad, has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that capacity utilization improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Over the last few years, capacity utilization has steadily improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Actual production capacity utilization was 52.7% in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reported that long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores in FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to just INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores FY25.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that the debt-to-equity ratio improved significantly from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio has improved significantly from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that short-term borrowings stood at INR17.1 crores, comprising working capital facilities.
capital_allocation.quote: Short-term borrowings stood at INR17.1 crores and primarily comprise of working capital facilities used to support inventory and receivable funding requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Management highlighted that more than 35% of FY26 year-end receivables had already been realized as of May.
capital_allocation.quote: Importantly, collections remain healthy, intact, and as of May this fiscal year, more than 35% of our FY26 year-end receivables have already been realized.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the business exhibits seasonality with approximately 55% of annual revenue generated in the second half of the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is worth noting that our business exhibits a degree of seasonality with approximately 55% of annual revenue typically generated during the second half of the year, and nearly 30% plus during the fourth quarter alone.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out that the West Asia crisis caused immediate price rises in crude-linked raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: So there was an immediate price rise, but we maintained a good balance of existing inventory, incoming inventory, and spot market prices, and had good communication with our customers and started implementing the price increase to them.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management mentioned that trade receivables showed an elevated number due to high fourth-quarter revenue contribution.
risks_headwinds.quote: Quarter four itself contributed over 32% of our annual revenue. So the figure that you see in the books, which is around INR48 crores as trade receivables, reflects a weighted average of around 160 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to bringing trade receivables down to around 120 days by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: we aim to bring it to around 120 days, maybe by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
